questions.q: What is the capital of Senegal?
questions.why: It is the westernmost city of mainland Africa.

questions.q: From which country did Senegal gain independence in 1960?
questions.why: It briefly joined Mali in a federation.

questions.q: Who was Senegal's first President and a famous poet?
questions.why: He helped found the Négritude movement.

questions.q: Which island off Dakar was a centre of the slave trade?
questions.why: Its 'Door of No Return' is famous.

questions.q: What is Senegal's currency?
questions.why: It is shared by eight countries.

questions.q: Which country is almost surrounded by Senegal?
questions.why: It follows the Gambia River.

questions.q: Who became President of Senegal in 2024?
questions.why: He was the youngest elected President in Africa.

questions.q: Which Senegalese singer is famous for 'Seven Seconds' with Neneh Cherry?
questions.why: He was also Minister of Culture.

questions.q: Which old capital is on an island in the Senegal River?
questions.why: It was capital of French West Africa.

questions.q: Which Sufi brotherhood is centred in the holy city of Touba?
questions.why: Its founder was Cheikh Amadou Bamba.

questions.q: Which riflemen from West Africa fought for France in the World Wars?
questions.why: The 1944 Thiaroye massacre involved them.

questions.q: Which federation did Senegal briefly form in 1959–60?
questions.why: It split after two months.

questions.q: Which confederation did Senegal form with The Gambia from 1982 to 1989?
questions.why: It was dissolved in 1989.

questions.q: Which Senegalese film director is called the father of African cinema?
questions.why: He made 'Black Girl' in 1966.

questions.q: Which historian argued that ancient Egyptians were Black Africans?
questions.why: Dakar's university is named after him.

questions.q: Which pink lake near Dakar gets its colour from algae?
questions.why: Salt collectors work in it.

questions.q: Which spicy fish and rice dish is Senegal's national dish?
questions.why: It is said to be the origin of jollof.

questions.q: Which famous rally used to end in Dakar?
questions.why: It moved to South America in 2009.

questions.q: Which giant bronze statue overlooks Dakar?
questions.why: It is taller than the Statue of Liberty.

questions.q: Which traditional wrestling is Senegal's most popular sport?
questions.why: Matches fill stadiums.

questions.q: What is the main language spoken in Senegal besides French?
questions.why: Most people understand it.

questions.q: Which country did Senegal beat in its first World Cup game in 2002?
questions.why: France were the defending champions.

questions.q: Which Senegalese striker played for Liverpool and Bayern Munich?
questions.why: He won the Champions League with Liverpool.

questions.q: In which year did Senegal win the Africa Cup of Nations?
questions.why: They beat Egypt on penalties.

questions.q: Which national park is a famous bird sanctuary on the Senegal River?
questions.why: Millions of birds spend winter there.

questions.q: Which hibiscus drink is a Senegalese favourite?
questions.why: It is deep red.

questions.q: Which delta of mangroves and islands is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It has huge shell mounds.

questions.q: Which southern region is known for its forests and Diola people?
questions.why: It had a long separatist conflict.

questions.q: Which Senegalese defender captained Napoli and played for Chelsea?
questions.why: He was born in France.

questions.q: Which chicken dish with lemon and onions comes from Casamance?
questions.why: It is marinated for hours.
